title: Rava bar Ahina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Menachot 37b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.37b.9), disagreeing with Rav Yosef. He is mentioned as “Bar Ahina” in [Kiddushin 51a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.51a.10), where Rava says he received the explanation from Bar Ahina. Hyman suggests two possibilities. Menachot may originally have had Rava report Bar Ahina’s teaching about a tallit. Alternatively, Kiddushin may originally have had Rava credit the explanation to Rava bar Ahina, with a copyist later omitting one occurrence of “Rava.”

notes.text: [Menachot 37b:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.37b.9) names Rava bar Ahina in the discussion of a five-cornered garment. In the separate betrothal discussion at [Kiddushin 51a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.51a.10), Rava says that Bar Ahina explained the point to him. The proposed missing word is Hyman’s reconstruction.
